Building: Palais Garnier, Paris (opera house).
The front (−z) is the main front facing the Avenue de l’Opéra.
Footprint: 101.7 m along x by 152.8 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-50.8,-1.6],[-50.8,-4.5],[-33.7,-64.4],[-29.5,-76.4],[29,-76.4],[33.2,-64.4],[50.8,-4.2],[50.8,-1.2],[33.2,56.3],[28.9,64.9],[21.5,76.4],[-22.4,76.4],[-29.7,64.7],[-33.8,56.3]]
Height: the highest point is 56 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front facade, eye level: loggia, central pediment and green dome behind, gilded statues at the corners, blue sky
  2. elevated rooftop view of the stage-house gable and side wing with the Eiffel Tower in the distance, clear sky
  3. elevated rooftop view of the great stage house and the green dome at left, overcast

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: The Palais Garnier is a long classical front range with an arcaded ground floor, a two-storey loggia of columns and a balustraded attic, all about 30 m high. A projecting central pavilion carries a triangular pediment, with a green copper dome rising behind it and gilded statue groups on its roof corners. The tall stage house with its great gable roof stands at the rear, with mostly blank walls and banded upper storeys.
